long_biography.plain_text:
Industrial raw-materials trading gave Rinat Akhmetov his entry into business after the Soviet collapse. He focused on coking coal, coke and metals, then acquired minority stakes in coke and metallurgical plants. By pursuing vertical integration and buying larger industrial assets, he assembled the portfolio that became SCM, with Metinvest as its mining-and-steel core.

Football became a parallel test of his investment approach. Akhmetov took charge of Shakhtar Donetsk when the club lacked a stadium and training base, then backed an academy, facilities and international recruitment. The club grew into a regular domestic champion and won the UEFA Cup, turning a childhood allegiance into a sustained institution-building project.
